sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE VIII OF 2000
BALOCHISTAN CANAL
AND DRAINAGE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE VIII OF
2000
An Ordinance
further to amend the Balochistan Canal and Drainage Ordinance, 1980
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 17th November, 2000]
No. Legis. 1-54/Law/80, dated
17-11-2000.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Balochistan on
13th November, 2000, is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Balochistan Canal and
Drainage (Amendment) Ordinance, 2000.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Canal and Drainage Amendment Ordinance 2000
sections.description:
Insertion of new sections 43-A, 43-B, 43-C and 43-D in Ordinance XX of 1980

ORDINANCE VIII OF 2000
BALOCHISTAN CANAL
AND DRAINAGE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE VIII OF
2000
An Ordinance
further to amend the Balochistan Canal and Drainage Ordinance, 1980
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 17th November, 2000]
No. Legis. 1-54/Law/80, dated
17-11-2000.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Balochistan on
13th November, 2000, is hereby published for general information:--
3. Insertion of new sections
43-A, 43-B, 43-C and 43-D in Ordinance XX of 1980.--In the said Ordinance
after section 43, the following new sections 43-A to 43-D, shall be added,
namely:--
"43-A. Cropping
pattern.--(1) Whenever it is found expedient, for the purposes of checking
water-logging or salinity, or for complying with the designed parameters of the
concerned canal system, or for any other good cause, the Government may, by
notification lay-down a cropping pattern, for cultivation of crops.
(2) Such cropping pattern may
lay-down percentage of total command area, or percentage of cropping intensity,
to be followed for cultivation of specified crops, by each tenant, occupier or
landowner.
(3) The Government may lay-down
such cropping pattern for periods exceeding one cropping season.
43-B. Ban of
cultivation.--The Government may, by notification impose ban on cultivation
of certain, crops in lands situated outside the canal command area.
43-C. Use of
canal water.--Any canal water used for cultivation in violation of the
conditions laid-down under section 43-A, shall be deemed to be a use in an
unauthorised manner, in terms of section 32 of this Ordinance.
43-D. Penalty.--Whoever
cultivates specified crop in violation of the conditions laid down in the
notifications issued under section 43-A, shall be punished with imprisonment of
either description for a term which may not exceed three months or with fine
amounting to twenty thousand rupees per acre, or with both. The crop sown in
the area, in excess of permissible limit, notified under this part, shall also
be liable to forfeiture. "
